about_item: GREAT FOR TRAINING - The leash tightens when your dog pulls and loosens when the behavior is corrected. Slip lead easily stops your dog from pulling with no harm. Also great for walking, jogging, training, crate transfer and potty breaks for your pet.

COLLAR AND LEASH IN ONE – This slip leash is convenient as it can be used without a collar or harness. It can be adjusted to fit any dog’s neck size by adjusting the leather stopper. Simply place the loop over your dog’s head and you’ll be ready to go.
HIGHLY REFLECTIVE – Reflective thread braided throughout the leash ensures that you and your dog are safe and visible during late-night walks

DURABLE LEASH - The leash is made of heavy-duty mountain climbing rope, and the woven polyester material provides maximum durability, making it able to sustain even the strongest pulling. The use of high quality metal O-ring and leather enhances the durability.

PERFECT SIZE – 5FT leash is perfect length for your dog to be safe under your control while providing enough freedom between you and your dog. Available in two sizes, 3/8" (9mm) for puppy and small breeds, 1/2" (13mm) for medium and large breeds.

authors_reviews.title: Converted harness user to a slip leash
authors_reviews.text: We have a big boy, and we’ve used every harness out there. Our trainer used only a slip leash and had much better control of our boy. This slip leash is thick (1/2”) but not too thick to get a good fit around the neck. It’s easy to adjust to size with the leather stopper. We find this slip leash prevents our boy from pulling and we can have a nice leisurely walk. This is new for us since we’ve only used harnesses because our boy is big. I was worried about him slipping out but if it’s fit properly, he can’t get loose. This leash helps continue our training, stops the pulling, and is much, much easier to get on him than a harness. He hates wearing a harness, but this is super simple to use, and he happily complies during the few seconds it takes to put on.
authors_reviews.author: Renee M

authors_reviews.title: Perfect
authors_reviews.text: Great slip lead. Easy to use, size is perfect and comfortable to hold, made nicely so it’s durable. If your dog breaks this, then it’s not ready to be walked with a slip lead. There is no way it’ll just break from a few tugs. Your dog has to be crazy. Very nice slip lead, I will buy more colors!
authors_reviews.author: Kellie

authors_reviews.title: Great tool
authors_reviews.text: This tool is amazing for teaching a dog engagement and leash walking skills. You can easily make a dog yield to the pressure. This product is affordable and has great value.After trying it for the first time, though, I realized it wasn’t the fit for me and my dog. Maybe it’s my like of handling skills, but it would slip from one side to another of his neck and would not stay fastened. I would need to train more with it in the future. I know it’s an amazing product, so I’m not discrediting it at all. This tool is very durable as well. I am currently using a prong collar and it has worked well for us. I will transition to the slip lead again once I am comfortable.This tool is amazing and I’m so glad I have it!!

other_countries_reviews.title: Amazing product!
other_countries_reviews.text: This is the perfect balance between a thick nylon collar and a chain to teach respect and not to pull. My 3.5 month old puppy caught on to a small amount of pressure when correcting pulling within 1 walk. It also immediately releases all pressure when no pulling and is really light on their neck. Also has a nice comfortable handle for you and nice length. Would recommend but always make sure you know what you’re doing with this kind of collar. YouTube has great videos to teach how to train safely with this kind of collar.
